about: Shared cases for the calendar module (KIST calendar profile §2). Written by tools/calendar-vectors.mjs; the JS and Kotlin copies must give `expect` exactly, and `canon` byte for byte. Times are ms; devices are 8 hex.

stamp.name: new event
stamp.why: a new entry stamps every field it has, at the clock

stamp.name: mac renames
stamp.why: only the changed field gets a new stamp

stamp.name: mac moves it
stamp.why: only the changed field gets a new stamp

stamp.name: stale pixel changes the time
stamp.why: the Pixel still has the first version; it stamps only the time

stamp.name: slow pixel renames after seeing it
stamp.why: the Pixel clock is an hour behind; t = the seen t + 1

stamp.name: slow pixel changes a field untouched since the start
stamp.why: t = max(clock, T + 1), past what it saw

stamp.name: fast pixel renames
stamp.why: the Pixel clock is two days ahead

stamp.name: mac renames after seeing it
stamp.why: t = the fast stamp + 1, so the next edit still wins

stamp.name: mac cancels
stamp.why: a cancel is a field like any other

stamp.name: pixel moves one Tuesday
stamp.why: an instance holds only what differs; the id is fixed by the series and the original time

stamp.name: mac moves the same Tuesday to a room
stamp.why: made offline at the same time, so the same entry

stamp.name: mac clears the url field
stamp.why: a field taken out is a change: it keeps a stamp and no value

stamp.name: a free range
stamp.why: DMs: a range is an event with only a start, an end and busy

merge.name: stale device
merge.why: the stale Pixel wins only the time it changed; the Mac keeps its newer title and place

merge.name: clock behind
merge.why: the slow Pixel's title still beats the one it saw; the web's place stays

merge.name: clock ahead
merge.why: a fast clock wins the same-field clash it is part of (the loser stays in history)

merge.name: clock ahead, then fixed
merge.why: the edit made after seeing the fast one wins

merge.name: same t, d decides
merge.why: equal t: the higher d wins (a1b2c3d4 > 0f0e0d0c)

merge.name: edit beats delete
merge.why: one version is a deletion: the merge is the edit, never the deletion

merge.name: cancel and edit at once
merge.why: a cancelled event with the edit in it, not a gone one

data.text: Bring the form and the card

merge.name: two deletions
merge.why: every version is a deletion: one deletion

merge.name: two edits and two deletions
merge.why: the edits merge among themselves; the deletions are dropped

Bring the form and the card

merge.name: the same instance from two devices
merge.why: both changes to that Tuesday are kept

merge.name: merge of a merge
merge.why: merging a merge alone gives it back

merge.name: merge with one of its inputs
merge.why: a merge already holds what its inputs had

merge.name: a removed field
merge.why: the newer removal beats the older value

merge.name: equal stamps, different values
merge.why: never in practice: the higher canonical JSON wins, so every device agrees

merge.name: equal stamps, value and no value
merge.why: a value beats no value, so nothing is dropped

merge.name: a version with only the changed field
merge.why: a version may carry just the fields it changed; the rest come from the others

merge.name: a malformed stamp
merge.why: a malformed stamp counts as no stamp, and is left out of the merge

instance_view.name: series renamed, instance moved
instance_view.why: the instance shows the series' new title with its own time and place

instance_view.name: instance renamed, series renamed
instance_view.why: the instance's own title stays; a null field falls back to the series
